theater: 馬其頓（佩拉與色薩利之間）

battle.name: 反馬其頓叛亂
battle.theater: 馬其頓（佩拉與色薩利之間）
battle.brief: 公元前332年冬，亞歷山大大帝遠在埃及，攝政安提帕特洛斯平定馬其頓阿爾哈巴奧斯自立王位的叛亂，色薩利同盟亦起兵脫離馬其頓霸權。叛軍多為舊式重裝步兵，以圓盾短矛列方陣；鎮壓軍以薩里沙長矛方陣與重騎兵壓上。卡面斯巴達長矛正是這條希臘矛兵傳統的祖型，勝負落在方陣與矛長的差距上。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 這場叛亂爆發在亞歷山大大帝遠征亞洲的第二年，主要交戰的兩方都在馬其頓王國境內：反叛方是趁國君不在而自立為王的王位爭奪者阿爾哈巴奧斯，以及一批手持王位宣稱、靠舊式民兵與城邦援助的僭主；忠於亞歷山大的一方由攝政安提帕特洛斯率領，他是腓力二世的老臣，亞歷山大西征前把守護本國的重任交給他。與此同時，在馬其頓的南面，色薩利同盟的城邦也起兵脫離馬其頓的霸權，捲入同一場風波，逼得安提帕特洛斯必須在兩個戰區之間分兵。鎮壓方的兵力核心是馬其頓王國的常備軍與徵召兵：以重裝步兵方陣為骨幹，輔以馬其頓重騎兵與弓箭手；安提帕特洛斯還得到所謂埃庇克涅米德地區的洛克里亞人這支部聯軍的支援，古代記述把這支部援軍的到場視為扭轉色薩利戰局的一環。反叛方的編制較雜：馬其頓本土幾座城鎮的民兵、隨僭主而來的希臘盟邦傭兵，以及色薩利人自有的重裝與輕裝部隊，武器與訓練多屬舊式hoplite系統。指揮系統方面，馬其頓並無成文的繼承程序，國君在位即是合法性的來源，因此每一次攝政空缺或國君遠征都會同時產生數個軍團的王位宣稱；安提帕特洛斯的權力來自亞歷山大的委任與對佩拉王廷的控制，叛軍的權力則來自血統與盟邦的支持，兩邊都自稱代表馬其頓的正統。
countriesEn: This revolt broke out in the second year of Alexander the Great's campaign in Asia, and the main clash on both sides lay inside the Macedonian kingdom. The rebel side was a claimant to the throne, Arrhabaeus, who had taken the crown while the king was far away, together with a set of pretenders who carried claims of their own and relied on old-style levies and on the help of allied Greek cities. The side loyal to Alexander was led by the regent Antipater, an old servant of Philip II to whom the king had entrusted the defence of the homeland before setting out east. At the same time, to the south of Macedonia, the cities of the Thessalian League also rose against Macedonian hegemony and were drawn into the same disturbance, which forced Antipater to divide his forces between two theatres. The core of the suppressing force was the standing army and the levy of the Macedonian kingdom: a phalanx of heavy infantry as its skeleton, supported by Macedonian heavy cavalry and archers. Antipater was also assisted by the Locrians of the country called the Epicnemidians, and the ancient accounts treat the arrival of this allied contingent as the element that turned the Thessalian campaign. The rebel organisation was more mixed: militias from several Macedonian towns, Greek mercenaries who had come over to the pretender, and the Thessalians' own heavy and light troops, most of them armed and trained in the older hoplite manner. As for command, Macedonia had no written rules of succession, and the mere presence of a king at the head of the state was itself the source of legitimacy; every regency and every absence of the king therefore produced several competing claims at the same moment. Antipater's authority derived from Alexander's appointment and from control of the court at Pella, while the rebels' authority derived from blood and from the support of allies, and both camps described themselves as the true Macedonian line.
people: 留下姓名的有四類。第一類是攝政安提帕特洛斯（Antipater of Pella，約公元前397年－公元前319年）：腓力二世時期的老臣，亞歷山大西征前留下他守護馬其頓，他以實務見長，處理希臘城邦問題時常用外交與金錢並行；這次平叛顯示他寧可獨自承擔風險，也不輕易把王國的兵權分給他人，戰後他仍留鎮歐洲，直到亞歷山大死後才在繼業者戰爭中與波利佩爾孔對峙。第二類是阿爾哈巴奧斯（Arrhabaeus）：馬其頓王室的旁支，自立為王，挑戰亞歷山大的繼承權；關於他的出身與背後支持，古代記載殘缺不全，通行說法認為他得到波斯方面的支持，並在馬其頓北部與若干盟邦得到響應，最終在戰敗後退往亞洲，據記載他此後曾企圖重返王位，在繼業者戰爭的末段被殺。第三類是遠在前線的亞歷山大大帝本人：他自公元前334年率軍渡海東征，馬其頓的留守由他親自指定；公元前332年冬他人在敘利亞與埃及，不可能及時回應，所以平叛的功勞全部落在攝政身上，這也解釋了為何朝廷把安提帕特洛斯視為不可或缺的柱石。第四類是色薩利方面與希臘城邦的介入者：色薩利同盟的領袖姓名在殘篇中多已失傳，安提帕特洛斯在色薩利取勝後曾俘虜其首領；一些城邦曾試圖以金錢或海路支援叛軍，但沒有留下確鑿的參戰記載。值得一併注意的是哲學家亞里士多德的姪子卡利斯塞涅斯：亞里士多德傳記的殘篇記載他死於馬其頓內戰的營中，學界多認為所指的正是這類王位內鬥，只是無法確定是公元前336年那一次還是這一次。
peopleEn: Four kinds of people are named in what survives. The first is the regent Antipater of Pella, born about 397 BC and died in 319 BC: an old servant of Philip II, left by Alexander in charge of Macedonia before the march east, a man of practical turn who combined diplomacy with money when dealing with the Greek cities. This suppression showed that he preferred to carry the risk himself rather than lightly divide the kingdom's military authority; after it he still sat in the west, and it was not until after Alexander's death that he faced Polyperchon in the wars of the Diadochi. The second is Arrhabaeus, a side branch of the Macedonian royal house who set himself up as king and challenged Alexander's succession. The ancient record about his origins and his backers is fragmentary; the usual account holds that he had support from the Persian side and that he drew a response in northern Macedonia and in a few allied cities; he was defeated in the end and withdrew to Asia, and the record has it that he later tried to return to the throne and was killed in the last phase of the wars of the successors. The third is Alexander the Great himself, far away at the front: he had crossed to Asia in 334 BC and personally appointed the men who would hold Macedonia, and in the winter of 332 BC he was in Syria and Egypt and could not possibly answer in time. The whole credit for the suppression therefore fell to the regent, which is why the court treated Antipater as an indispensable pillar. The fourth group is made up of the Thessalian side and the Greek cities that intervened. The names of the Thessalian leaders are mostly lost in the fragments, and Antipater took the leader of the Thessalians captive after his victory there; some cities tried to assist the rebels with money or by sea, but no firm record of their participation survives. Worth noting alongside these is Callisthenes, the nephew of the philosopher Aristotle: the fragmentary Life of Aristotle says that he died in a Macedonian camp during a civil war, and most scholars take this to refer to a struggle over the crown of exactly this kind, though they cannot decide whether it was the rising of 336 BC or this one.
kits: 卡面上的武器是斯巴達長矛（dory）：一柄約兩米長的直木槍，前端裝青銅矛頭，槍尾有金屬套，在近身纏鬥時可以架在敵人喉嚨與胸甲之間把他頂開。它配的是hoplite重裝步兵的全套裝備——面對圓盾（aspis）、青銅或亞麻胸甲、青銅脛甲、頭盔、短劍，以及手裡的長矛；盾牌掛在左臂，長矛握在右手，因此方陣中每個人的矛都從右肩斜伸到身前同伴的空隙。斯巴達人把這套裝備推到極致，斯巴達的重裝步兵在方陣中靠圓盾彼此遮蔽，矛頭從盾縫間探出，列陣的密度與行軍的耐力都成為這支部隊的招牌。然而到了公元前332年，馬其頓本國的步兵早已改用另一套裝備：長達五米半到六米的薩里沙長矛（sarissa）、更小的盾牌，以及被編為縱深方陣的密集隊形，衝撞力遠勝希臘城邦的hoplite方陣。安提帕特洛斯掌握的正是這支薩里沙方陣軍；叛軍能倚賴的卻主要是舊式hoplite征召兵與盟邦民兵，他們的方陣是封閉的、慢的、靠盾沿硬推的，正好被馬其頓的長矛從正面與側面同時刺穿。色薩利方面以騎兵與投槍手見長，馬其頓重騎兵的正面衝鋒與色薩利騎兵的機動纏鬥，正是安提帕特洛斯取勝的兩把武器；安提帕特洛斯在色薩利所獲的援手，正是埃庇克涅米德地區的洛克里亞人步兵。整場戰役沒有攻城器與遠程攻城武器的記載，全是野戰與追擊；後勤靠馬其頓大平原的穀物、牛車，以及夏季乾季中的連續行軍。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Spartan dory: a straight wooden spear some two metres long, with a bronze head at the front and a metal butt-cap at the rear, which could be braced under an opponent's throat or against his breastplate to push him off in a close struggle. It belonged to the full kit of the hoplite heavy infantry: the face-to-face round shield (aspis), a bronze or linen corselet, bronze greaves, a helmet, a short sword, and the spear in the hand. The shield was carried on the left arm and the spear gripped in the right, so in the phalanx every man's spear was extended diagonally from his right shoulder into the gap before his companion. The Spartans carried this kit to its extreme, their heavy infantry closing up behind their round shields with the spearheads reaching out between them, and the density of the line and the endurance of the march became the signature of that corps. By 332 BC, however, the foot of Macedon itself had already moved to a different kit: the sarissa, a pike five and a half to six metres long, a smaller shield, and a deep dense formation in which the phalanx was organised, all of it far more shock-effective than the hoplite phalanx of the Greek cities. What Antipater commanded was precisely this sarissa army; what the rebels could rely on was chiefly old-style hoplite levies and allied militia, whose phalanx was closed, slow and pushed forward on the edge of the shield, and exactly the sort of formation that the Macedonian pikes could pierce at once from the front and the flank. Thessaly was famous for its cavalry and its javelin-men, and the frontal charge of the Macedonian heavy horse together with the mobile fighting of the Thessalian riders were the two weapons of Antipater's victory; the help Antipater received in Thessaly was precisely the infantry of the Locrians of Epicnemidia. Nothing in the campaign is recorded of siege engines or of far-firing artillery: the whole war was open-field fighting and pursuit, with the grain of the Macedonian plain, ox carts and continuous marching through the dry season of summer carrying the supply.
tactics: 反叛方能倚仗的，是傳統hoplite作戰法：集結城鎮民兵與盟邦步兵，排成密集的方陣，以圓盾抵住前排，以短矛與短劍在盾縫中砍刺，向正面硬推；這套戰術要求平坦地形與充足體力，在色薩利平原上可以施展，在馬其頓的山地隘道與河谷裡卻處處受制。鎮壓方的戰術圍繞三件事展開。第一是控制交通：馬其頓的核心是佩拉與阿伊蓋所在的河谷，東邊有阿克西奧斯河與海岸線可通往外邦，叛軍若要取得外部援助，必須奪取渡口與山道；安提帕特洛斯把兵鋒指向這些節點，使叛軍無法與色薩利及海上的援助會合。第二是集中優勢兵力：亞歷山大東征前留給歐洲的軍力以數萬計，安提帕特洛斯得以在兩個戰區之間選擇先打哪一邊，他的決定是先把色薩利方向壓平；按阿里安的記載，他與埃庇克涅米德地區的洛克里亞人會合後取得一場大勝，並俘虜了色薩利一方的首領。第三是利用攻守之勢：叛軍分散於色薩利與馬其頓兩地，安提帕特洛斯每到一處都是集中對分散，用薩里沙方陣的正面壓力加上重騎兵的衝鋒，在開闊地一舉壓垮舊式hoplite方陣；對方一旦在正面受挫，崩潰的方陣沒有縱深可以收縮，整列便會失去秩序。同一套戰術語言在安提帕特洛斯日後對斯巴達王阿基斯二世作戰時再次出現：公元前318年的梅加洛波利斯戰役，他仍是以方陣加騎兵的組合取勝，鎮壓叛亂的經驗就這樣被帶進了伯羅奔尼撒的野地。
tacticsEn: What the rebels could rely on was the traditional hoplite method of war: mustering the militia of the towns and the allied infantry into a dense phalanx, holding the front with round shields, cutting and thrusting with short spears and swords in the gaps between shields, and pushing hard straight ahead. That method demanded level ground and fresh bodies: it could be played out on the plain of Thessaly, but in the passes and valleys of Macedonia it was checked at every step. The tactics of the suppressing side turned on three things. The first was the control of communications. The core of Macedonia lay in the valleys of Pella and Aegae, with the river Axios and the coastline on the east giving the way out to the rest of the world; if the rebels were to obtain outside help they had to seize fords and mountain tracks, and Antipater pointed his columns at those nodes, so that the rebels could not join up with Thessaly or with help from the sea. The second was the concentration of superior force. Alexander had left tens of thousands in Europe before he marched east, and Antipater was able to choose which of the two theatres to deal with first; his choice was to flatten the Thessalian side, and by the account of Arrian, after joining with the Locrians of Epicnemidia he won a great battle and took the leader of the Thessalians captive. The third was the relation of attack and defence. The rebels were scattered between Thessaly and Macedonia, so wherever Antipater appeared he brought concentrated force against divided force, and the frontal pressure of the sarissa phalanx together with the charge of the heavy horse crushed the old hoplite phalanx in the open; once that formation had been checked in front it had no depth in which to recover, and the whole line lost its order. The same tactical language reappeared when Antipater fought King Agis II of Sparta: at Megalopolis in 318 BC he again won with the combination of phalanx and cavalry, and so the experience of crushing the revolt was carried into the open country of the Peloponnese.
data: 可核對的數字有幾組，來源可靠程度不一。留守馬其頓的兵力：狄奧多羅斯記亞歷山大東征時留下安提帕特洛斯與超過四萬步兵、五千餘騎兵守備本國；阿里安則不給確數，只說留守的軍力相當可觀。東征軍本身的規模，狄奧多羅斯記為約三萬二千步兵、五千騎兵，阿里安提到渡海時約有五百騎兵，兩說互相矛盾，說明這些數字多來自事後追述。亞歷山大帶往亞洲的色薩利騎兵，一般認為在二千騎上下，這支部隊被視為他最可靠的騎兵來源。色薩利同盟在四世紀前半葉有二十餘座城（說法不一），聯軍兵員沒有留下可信數字。距離與時間：由佩拉到色薩利前沿，直線約一百公里上下，循古道則更遠；叛亂自公元前332年冬爆發，至公元前331年亞歷山大的大軍回到歐洲時已被平定，整場戰爭的跨度不足一年。馬其頓王國的核心地（下馬其頓）約二萬五千至三萬平方公里，連同上馬其頓與色雷斯的領地，疆域在數萬平方公里上下，可徵兵的上限亦在數萬人量級，學界沒有更細的估算。地名的考訂同樣不統一：阿爾哈巴奧斯起兵的地點、決定性的會戰所在，以及安提帕特洛斯擒獲色薩利首領的戰場，都沒有留下可以定位的記載，學者多把戰場放在色薩利平原與馬其頓南部山區之間的地帶，各說互有出入，應視為尚未定論的問題。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked fall into several groups of very different reliability. The force left to hold Macedonia: Diodorus records that Alexander left Antipater with more than forty thousand foot and over five thousand horse to guard the kingdom, while Arrian gives no exact figure and says only that the force left behind was considerable. The size of the expedition itself: Diodorus gives about thirty-two thousand foot and five thousand horse, while Arrian speaks of about five hundred cavalry at the crossing, and the two accounts contradict each other, which shows that these figures come largely from later reconstruction. The Thessalian cavalry taken to Asia by Alexander is generally put at around two thousand riders, and this contingent is treated as his most reliable source of horse. The Thessalian League had some twenty-odd cities in the first half of the fourth century BC, the figures varying, and no credible number survives for the size of its levy. Distance and time: from Pella to the front in Thessaly is roughly a hundred kilometres as the crow flies and rather more by the old roads; the revolt broke out in the winter of 332 BC and was already crushed by the time Alexander's army came back to Europe in 331 BC, so that the whole war covered less than a year. The heartland of the Macedonian kingdom, the lower Macedonia, amounts to some twenty-five to thirty thousand square kilometres; with Upper Macedonia and the Thracian territories added, the realm lay over some tens of thousands of square kilometres, and the ceiling of men it could levy was of the order of tens of thousands, with no finer estimate offered by scholarship. The identification of place names is equally unsettled: the point at which Arrhabaeus rose, the site of the decisive battle, and the field on which Antipater took the Thessalian leader captive have all left no locatable record. Scholars mostly place the fighting in the belt between the plain of Thessaly and the highlands of southern Macedonia, the various proposals disagreeing, and this should be treated as an open question.
cause: 原因有四層，層層相扣。最內層是馬其頓的權力繼承沒有制度：亞歷山大的祖父阿明塔斯三世、父親腓力二世都是靠內鬥與暗殺取得王位，腓力二世晚年指定長子亞歷山大繼位，卻把其餘的兒子安排成副手與象徵性的王，於是每一次攝政或國君遠征都會產生新的王位宣稱者，阿爾哈巴奧斯正是這樣的一個旁支。第二層是前例：公元前336年，腓力二世剛被暗殺，亞歷山大即位數月就遇上帕烏桑尼亞斯，即阿明塔斯三世的私生子、腓力同父異母的兄弟，他自立為王，據說還把王室的部分財物運往波斯；這次叛亂很快被鎮壓，但它示範了一條可行的路徑，也讓朝野記住了王室的財寶與王室血統都可以拿來做旗號。第三層是亞歷山大的長期缺席：他自公元前334年東征，前線遠在敘利亞、埃及與亞洲腹地，馬其頓的決策只能由攝政安提帕特洛斯與王廷中的羅克桑娜（Laodice）等少數人分擔，遠方的人心與消息都靠書信和使節維持，傳遞一次往返便要數月。第四層是希臘世界的敵意與不滿：馬其頓控制希臘的方式是留駐軍、扶植傀儡、拆散城邦同盟，公元前335年焚底比斯、此前在拉里薩海灣大勝之後，希臘城邦對馬其頓的恐懼與怨恨累積；亞歷山大還在國內徵集大批希臘少年作為人質與預備兵，據記載逾三萬人，其中上萬人受過馬其頓式訓練，脫隊或叛逃時常被處死，成為最深的一層怨憤。最外層是色薩利本身的利益：自腓力二世於公元前353至前352年介入色薩利之後，色薩利同盟一直是馬其頓的附庸，馳名的色薩利騎兵被亞歷山大帶往亞洲，一旦本土的徵召與稅賦被遠征軍持續抽調，這個曾經養出希臘世界最強騎兵的區域，就成了最不滿的角落。於是馬其頓內部的王位爭奪與色薩利的反霸權運動在同一年合流，成為一場內外勾連的叛亂。
causeEn: There are four layers of cause, each resting on the one below. The innermost is that Macedonia had no institutions of succession. Alexander's grandfather Amyntas III and his father Philip II had both taken the crown through internal strife and assassination, and when Philip late in his reign named his eldest son Alexander as heir he arranged his other sons as deputies and nominal kings; so every regency and every absence of the king produced new claimants to the throne, and Arrhabaeus was exactly such a side branch. The second layer is the precedent. In 336 BC, shortly after Philip II was assassinated, Alexander had been on the throne for a few months when Pausanias appeared: the illegitimate son of Amyntas III and half-brother of Philip, who set himself up as king and, according to the record, carried part of the royal treasure off to Persia. That rising was put down quickly, but it demonstrated a workable path, and the court learned that both the royal treasure and the royal blood could be turned into a banner. The third layer is Alexander's long absence. Since his departure in 334 BC the front lay far away in Syria, Egypt and the interior of Asia, and decisions in Macedonia could be taken only by the regent Antipater and a very few others at court, with Laodice among them, while news and opinion from the front travelled by letter and embassy, a single round trip taking months. The fourth layer is the resentment of the Greek world. The Macedonian way of ruling Greece was through resident garrisons, dependent puppet governments and the breaking up of city alliances, and after the bay of Larnaca and the burning of Thebes in 335 BC the fear and bitterness of the Greek cities against Macedon had accumulated. Alexander also levied large numbers of Greek boys at home as hostages and as a reserve, more than thirty thousand by the record, of whom over ten thousand were trained in Macedonian fashion, and those who slipped away or ran off were often put to death; this was the deepest layer of grievance. The outermost layer is the interest of Thessaly itself. Since Philip II's intervention in 352 and 351 BC the Thessalian League had been a Macedonian dependent, and the famous Thessalian horse was taken to Asia by Alexander; once the levies and the taxes of the homeland were drained continuously by the expedition, the region that had produced the strongest cavalry in the Greek world became the most aggrieved corner of it. The struggle over the Macedonian crown and the revolt of Thessaly against Macedonian hegemony thus merged in the same year into a rebellion with foreign connections.
impact: 這場叛亂的時間很短，影響卻不短。第一，它驗證了馬其頓國家的機制：在國君遠征亞洲的第三年，一場得到外部支持的王位挑戰被攝政在一年之內壓平，說明馬其頓的常備軍、方陣制度與徵召體系已能獨立運作，亞歷山大因此得以把注意力完全放在亞洲，這也成為他日後把安提帕特洛斯視為最可靠支柱的原因。第二，它確立了安提帕特洛斯個人的政治資本：此後十年他以攝政兼總督的身份坐鎮歐洲，徵募、稅收與外交都經他一手，直到公元前319年病逝為止。第三，它在希臘世界留下一個明確的信息——馬其頓的干預是有成本的。公元前331年以後，希臘城邦普遍採取避免正面抵抗的策略，注意力轉向亞洲戰線，波斯戰爭成了新的重心，這改變了希臘城邦在亞歷山大其後二十年的政治取向。第四，它延續並鞏固了方陣兵制：安提帕特洛斯在色薩利獲勝所用的，正是亞歷山大在亞洲倚重的薩里沙方陣加重騎兵的組合，說明這套兵制並非只靠亞歷山大的個人天才維持，背後有歐洲本土的兵源與訓練體系支撐；同一組合在公元前318年的梅加洛波利斯戰役中被安提帕特洛斯用來對付斯巴達王阿基斯二世，正是卡面這件斯巴達長矛的故鄉，四世紀末，馬其頓的薩里沙方陣與斯巴達的hoplite方陣在伯羅奔尼撒的野地上再會，斯巴達此後再無單獨挑戰馬其頓的機會。第五，就史料而言，這場叛亂的記載極為殘缺，主要靠阿里安《亞歷山大遠征記》第三卷、狄奧多羅斯與柯蒂烏斯的片段，以及亞里士多德傳記的殘篇，因此本卡所述的許多細節只能停留在古代記載如此這一層，學界對戰場位置、叛軍組成與聯軍兵力都沒有定論。
impactEn: The revolt was brief in time, but its consequences were not. First, it tested the machinery of the Macedonian state. In the third year of the king's campaign in Asia, a challenge to the throne that had foreign support was crushed by the regent within a year, which showed that the standing army, the phalanx system and the machinery of levy could now run on their own; Alexander was therefore free to give his whole attention to Asia, and this is part of why he afterwards treated Antipater as his most reliable pillar. Second, it established Antipater's personal political capital: for the next ten years he sat in the west as regent and governor, with the recruiting, the taxes and the diplomacy of the kingdom passing through his hands, until his death in 319 BC. Third, it left the Greek world with a clear message, that Macedonian intervention had a cost. After 331 BC the Greek cities generally adopted the strategy of avoiding open resistance and turned their attention to the war in Asia, where the conflict with Persia became the new centre of gravity; this altered the political orientation of the Greek cities for the twenty years after Alexander's death. Fourth, it carried on and consolidated the doctrine of the phalanx. What Antipater used to win in Thessaly was exactly the combination of the sarissa phalanx and heavy cavalry on which Alexander relied in Asia, which shows that this system was not sustained by Alexander's personal genius alone but had behind it the manning and the training system of the European homeland. The same combination was used by Antipater against King Agis II of Sparta at Megalopolis in 318 BC, in the homeland of the very weapon on this card: in the late fourth century BC the Macedonian sarissa phalanx and the Spartan hoplite phalanx met once more in the open country of the Peloponnese, and Sparta never had another opportunity to challenge Macedon on its own. Fifth, as a matter of the record, the sources for this revolt are extremely thin, resting mainly on Book Three of Arrian's Anabasis, on fragments of Diodorus and Curtius, and on the remnants of the Life of Aristotle. Many of the details given here therefore stay at the level of what the ancient authorities say, and there is no settled view among scholars on the position of the battlefield, on the composition of the rebel army or on the size of the coalition.
result: 公元前332年冬到前331年之間，結果是清楚的：反叛的兩條戰線都被壓平。色薩利方向，安提帕特洛斯與洛克里亞盟友合兵，在一場決定性的野戰中擊潰起兵的色薩利聯軍，按阿里安的記載，其首領被俘；馬其頓方向，阿爾哈巴奧斯的主力在戰鬥中被擊敗，他放棄佩拉與王都，帶著殘部退往亞洲，馬其頓的宗廟、王陵與國庫重新回到朝廷控制，王室財物的守護權再次確立，這是誰守住王室財產誰才有資格繼承這條原則的又一次實踐。公元前331年，亞歷山大的大軍渡過赫勒斯滂回到歐洲，叛亂已被平定，他沒有為此改變東征計畫，反而把安提帕特洛斯的權位正式提升為攝政兼總督，馬其頓本土的兵員、稅收與希臘城邦的朝貢都經他之手輸送亞洲。此後亞歷山大于伊蘇斯、高加米拉連勝波斯，叛亂的陰影再也沒有重演；直到公元前323年他病逝巴比倫、繼業者戰爭爆發，這場一年之內就被打敗的叛亂才被各方重新翻出來，作為說明攝政制度能撐住王國、也說明馬其頓真正的敵人從來不是蠻族而是內部的材料。若要一句總結：阿爾哈巴奧斯的失敗不在於他缺少希臘式方陣的技術，而在於他面對的是已經改用薩里沙長矛、能夠連續作戰並且能自己調度兵力的馬其頓國家；斯巴達長矛所代表的那一代hoplite世界，就在這一年裡正式退場。
resultEn: Between the winter of 332 BC and 331 BC the outcome was clear: both lines of the rebellion were flattened. In Thessaly, Antipater joined with his Locrian allies and in a decisive battle in the open field broke the Thessalian league that had risen, and by the account of Arrian its leader was taken captive. In Macedonia, the main force of Arrhabaeus was defeated in action; he gave up Pella and the royal capital and withdrew with the remnants of his force to Asia, while the sanctuaries, the royal tombs and the treasury of Macedonia came back under the control of the court, and the guardianship of the royal treasure was once more established, which is another practical working of the principle that whoever holds the royal treasure has the better claim to inherit. In 331 BC Alexander's army crossed back over the Hellespont into Europe and found the revolt already settled; he made no change to his plan in Asia on account of it, and instead formally raised Antipater's position to that of regent and governor, with the manning, the taxes and the tribute of the Greek cities all passing through his hands to feed the campaign in Asia. Alexander then won at Issus and at Gaugamela, and the shadow of the revolt never fell across his path again. It was not until his death at Babylon in 323 BC and the outbreak of the wars of the successors that this rebellion, defeated within a year, was taken up again by all parties as material for showing that the regency could hold the kingdom together, and that Macedon's true enemy had never been the barbarians but its own interior. To sum it up in one line: the failure of Arrhabaeus lay not in any lack of the technique of the Greek-style phalanx, but in the fact that he faced a Macedonian state that had already taken up the sarissa, could fight continuously, and could move its own troops between theatres; the generation of hoplite world that the Spartan dory stands for left the stage in that very year.
